aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Mother Candraghaṇṭā, abode of happiness;
Like the moon you are the giver of coolness,
and you dwell in the moon's bright rays.
aarti.pad2: You are the mistress of the mind, and you delight the heart;
Candraghaṇṭā, you are the giver of boons.
aarti.pad3: Whoever meditates on you every Wednesday,
makes an image in the shape of the moon
and lights a lamp of ghee before it,
aarti.pad4: and, bowing his head, tells what is in his heart —
fulfil his hope, O giver to the world.
aarti.pad5: I repeat your name, great Queen;
